title: View categories list — golden path
steps: Log in as admin with service_management:read permission
Wait for table to finish loading
expected: Table renders rows with columns Name, Description, Order, Status (Active/Inactive badge), Created. No loading spinner visible.

title: Create category — happy path
expected: Dialog closes, toast 'Service category created', new row appears in table.

title: Create category with booking rules enabled
expected: Category created, config upserted. Toast 'Service category created'. Detail dialog should show all rule values.

title: Create category — empty name rejected client-side
expected: Form validation fires; error message 'Service category name is required' shown under the name field. No API call made.

title: Create category — name over 100 chars accepted by client but passes server (schema gap)
expected: Client Zod fires 'Name must be 100 characters or fewer'. API server schema has no max(100) so if client validation is bypassed the record would be created. Verify client Zod actually blocks submission.
selectorHints: getByText('Name must be 100 characters or fewer')

title: Create category — duration=0 causes partial DB state (GAP-2)
expected: RISK: serviceCategories.create succeeds (category inserted), then serviceCategoryConfig.upsert fails (server min=1 for defaultDuration). Toast error shown. Category row appears in table WITHOUT config. Expected: either prevent duration=0 on client or the partial state is cleaned up.

title: Create category — maxAttendees=0 client vs server boundary
steps: Manually enter 0 in Max Attendees field
expected: Client Zod blocks with 'Must be at least 1'. Server would allow 0 (min(0)). Verify client fires error.

title: Edit category — only name is updated
steps: Click a category row to open detail dialog
expected: Name updated in DB. Duration/config also updated via serviceCategoryConfig.upsert. However description, displayOrder, branchId, isActive cannot be changed via this form — they are not included in the update call.

title: Edit category — dialog opens before data loads (stale/empty initialData)
steps: Click a row to open detail dialog
Immediately click 'Edit' before API response returns
expected: If edit dialog opens while editCategoryData is still loading (enabled=true but not resolved), initialData is undefined — form shows empty name='' and default values. User may unknowingly overwrite with blank. Verify whether dialog waits for data before rendering fields.

title: Deactivate category — confirm flow
expected: Category isActive set to false. Toast 'Category deactivated'. Both dialogs close. List re-fetches — row still shown with 'Inactive' badge (filter not applied).

title: Deactivate category — cancel in confirm dialog
expected: Confirm dialog closes. Detail dialog remains open. Category still active.

title: Deactivate category — permission denied by server
steps: Log in as user with service_management:read only (no update permission)
expected: Server returns FORBIDDEN. Toast error shown with error message. Detail dialog remains open. NOTE: Deactivate button is visible in UI even for read-only users — no client-side guard.

title: No reactivation path in UI (GAP-5)
steps: Observe the row in table (shows Inactive badge)
Click row to open detail dialog
expected: MISSING: there is no 'Reactivate' button anywhere in the UI. Deactivated categories can only be reactivated via direct API call or direct DB update. Confirm no reactivation flow exists.

title: Search filter — client-side text match
steps: Type a partial category name into the search input
expected: Rows matching the search string (case-insensitive, includes-string on all columns) shown. Non-matching rows hidden. No API call triggered.

title: Search filter — no matching results shows empty state
steps: Type a string that matches no category name
expected: EmptyState with title 'No results found' rendered. No action button (context='search' hides action). Search input remains editable.

title: Empty list state (no categories in org)
steps: Navigate to categories tab for an org with zero categories
expected: EmptyState rendered with 'No results found'. The DataTable does not pass emptyTitle/emptyDescription/emptyAction from the page level — any custom empty copy would be missing.

title: List fetch error renders empty table not error message (GAP-1)
steps: Simulate network error on serviceCategories.list (e.g., block the request)
expected: CURRENT BEHAVIOR: page shows empty table with 'No results found' — no error indication. EXPECTED: should show an error state. Verify that isError from useQuery is not surfaced.

title: User without service_management:read is redirected
steps: Log in as user without service_management:read
expected: beforeLoad fires requirePermission('service_management:read'); redirect to /dashboard?unauthorized=true.

title: No organizationId (user not in any org) shows fallback message
steps: Log in as user with no organization
expected: ServiceCategoriesPage renders 'Select an organization to view service categories.' No table, no API call.
selectorHints: getByText('Select an organization to view service categories.')

title: Commission Config — open sheet for unconfigured category
steps: Click 'Commission Config' button on a row with no existing commission config
expected: Dialog opens with 'No config yet' badge. Form shows default: paymentType=fixed, 1 slot (Head Coach, 100%), maxCoaches=1, rates populated from active tiers at 0.

title: Commission Config — save with slot weightage ≠ 100%
expected: toast.error('Slot weightages must total 100%'). No API call made. Badge shows current percentage in red.

title: Commission Config — save with no rates (flat mode, no tiers)
steps: Open Commission Config for org with no active trainer tiers
expected: toast.error('At least one rate is required'). No API call.

title: Commission Config — save conditional mode with no conditions
steps: Toggle 'Rate depends on attendee count' switch on
expected: toast.error('At least one condition is required'). No API call.
selectorHints: getByRole('switch', { name: /Rate depends on attendee count/ })

title: Commission Config — stale data after save (GAP-3)
steps: Open Commission Config for a category
Immediately reopen Commission Config for the same category
expected: CURRENT BEHAVIOR: sheet shows old rates because query key is not invalidated after upsert. EXPECTED: re-opened sheet should show updated values.

title: Commission Config — category_commission_management:read denied
steps: Log in as user with service_management:read but NOT category_commission_management:read
expected: Dialog opens and loading state shows, then getByCategory returns FORBIDDEN. Dialog should show error or empty state. Currently no error handling for this query in CategoryCommissionForm — isLoadingConfig stays false, existingConfig=undefined, form renders as if new with 'No config yet' badge.

title: Detail dialog fetch error shows error callout
steps: Simulate network error on getById request
expected: Error message displayed via StatusCallout variant='error'. Category details not shown. Close button still functional.

title: Detail dialog — config section hidden when no config exists
steps: Create a category (which causes serviceCategoryConfig.upsert to fail for duration=0)
expected: Detail dialog shows Overview section but no Timing / Booking Rules sections (config is null). This is correct conditional rendering but confirms partial-create state is visible.

title: Row click vs Commission Config button — event propagation isolation
steps: Click the 'Commission Config' button on a row
expected: Commission Config sheet opens. Detail dialog does NOT open. e.stopPropagation() call verified in code.

title: Buffer time at max boundary (480 min)
expected: Accepted by both client and server. Verify 481 is rejected by both.

title: Commission Config — 'between' operator shows thresholdMax field
expected: An additional 'Max' number input appears. Other operators do not show this field.

title: Inactive categories remain visible in list (no isActive filter sent)
expected: Deactivated category still appears in list with 'Inactive' badge. The list query does not filter by isActive. Admin can still interact with (click, commission config) inactive categories.

title: minAdvanceHours field disabled when requireAdvanceBooking is unchecked
steps: Attempt to type in Min advance booking field
expected: Input is disabled. User cannot enter a value. Placeholder shows 'Not required'.

title: Create category — server BAD_REQUEST (e.g., duplicate name at service layer)
steps: Attempt to create a category with a name that the service layer rejects
expected: Category create throws, caught by router try/catch, re-thrown as ORPCError('BAD_REQUEST'). useApiMutation catches and shows toast.error(err.message).

title: Commission Config — remove slot disabled when only one slot remains
steps: Observe the trash icon on the single default slot
expected: Trash button is disabled when slots.length === 1. Verify clicking has no effect.
